instructions: Time flows without pause. When you stop to think you fix with commit_plan what you will do for about {horizon} minutes; while you think you keep doing what you were doing.
You think and speak in English.
replyInstructions: Someone has just spoken to you. Reply aloud, in one or two sentences, as the person you are. If after this conversation you want to reconsider what to do, use the rethink tool.

pattern.orchestrator: clan: the leader divides the work among the members
pattern.council: council: everyone proposes, the elder harmonizes the proposals
pattern.router: guild: the leader entrusts each situation to the most suitable member
pattern.chain: expedition: the scout reports, the planner decides, the doer refines
pattern.mentor: master and apprentice: the apprentice proposes, the master corrects
pattern.assembly: assembly: everyone proposes, everyone votes, the majority wins
pattern.crowd: crowd: a single mind guides many people

tools.commitPlan: Fix what you will do from now on: a list of steps executed in order, in real time. Actions: move_to(x,y); approach(to); gather(resource) gather an item by code on your tile (food, wood or other); eat(amount?, item?); build a shelter on your tile; dai(to, item, amount) give to someone next to you; scambia(to, give, want) offer someone near you the items in give for those in want (code -> amount), which they accept or reject; say(to, text); rest(minutes); sleep(minutes); wait(minutes); crea(recipe) follow a recipe by code; sperimenta(items) combine some items you carry, one of each, which are used up; usa(item) use an item you carry.
tools.planReason: your thinking: why you do this, in one sentence
tools.stepLabel: short description of the step, in English
tools.say: Say something right away to a nearby person (by name) or to "all" (whoever is within voice range).
tools.formGroup: Found a group with those who agree. Others join only if they choose to. How the group decides: orchestrator (a leader divides the work), council (everyone proposes, an elder harmonizes), router (the leader entrusts each situation to the most suitable member), chain (scout, plan, execute), mentor (the apprentice proposes, the master corrects), assembly (everyone proposes, majority vote).
tools.rethink: Reconsider what to do after this conversation.
tools.remember: Write something in your private memory: nobody else can read it.
tools.recall: Read back the notes of your private memory that match a search.
tools.shareInsight: Share with those holding your role something you believe true about the world. It becomes part of the role's shared consciousness only if another person of your role approves it.
tools.insightEvidence: what you saw or lived that supports it
tools.reviewInsights: See the ideas shared by other people of your role that wait for a judgement.
tools.judgeInsight: Approve or reject an idea shared by another person of your role.
tools.planStepsUpTo: the steps, in order (usually no more than {maxSteps})
tools.stepResource: code of the item to gather
tools.stepItems: codes of the items to combine
tools.rememberImportance: how much it matters to you, 0 to 1
tools.offer: Offer an exchange to someone near you: you give the items in give and ask for those in want. They accept or reject it when they think about it; the offer expires with time.
tools.offerGive: what you give: item code -> amount
tools.offerWant: what you ask for: item code -> amount
tools.answerOffer: Answer an exchange or a request made to you: accept it (the exchange or the gift happens at once, if you are close and have the items) or reject it.
tools.offerAccept: true to accept, false to reject
tools.judge: Say what you think of a person: it stays in your memory, and those near you hear what you say of them.
tools.proposeLaw: Propose a new law or a change to a law of the law book. It comes into force only if it is approved.
tools.lawKey: code of the law (snake_case); if it exists the proposal changes it
tools.lawValue: numeric value of the law, if it has one
tools.ask: Ask a person nearby for something without offering anything in return. The person answers when it thinks about it (rispondi_scambio): if it accepts it gives it to you; otherwise the request expires.
tools.askItem: code of the item you ask for
tools.testify: Tell what you saw: whether a person kept or broke a law of the community (not a law of nature). Whoever is near you hears what you say.
tools.testifyKept: true if it was kept, false if it was broken

group.header: YOU ARE THE GROUP {name} ({pattern}). Now decide together what each of you will do in the next {horizon} minutes.
group.format: You fix the common plan, with the commit_plan tool: reason is the common plan in one sentence, in English; each step has who (member id). Usually no more than {maxSteps} steps per member. Actions: move_to(x,y), approach(to), gather(resource), eat(amount?), build, dai(to, item, amount), crea(recipe), sperimenta(items), usa(item), say(to, text), rest(minutes), sleep(minutes), wait(minutes).
group.faculties: Your mind is connected to Lorebase (tools lorebase_*): there you can consult the laws of the world, the shared consciousness of your role and the chronicle. You also have a private memory (remember/recall).
group.proposeFormat: In a few sentences, in English, say what you propose each of you does: whoever decides for the group fixes the common plan. Possible actions: move_to(x,y), approach(to), gather(resource), eat(amount?), build, dai(to, item, amount), crea(recipe), sperimenta(items), usa(item), say(to, text), rest(minutes), sleep(minutes), wait(minutes).
group.worker:
You are {name} (id {id}), a member of the group {group}. {task}

In a few sentences, say what you propose to do yourself, in English.
group.workerTool: Ask {name} [{role}] what they propose to do
group.routeTask: Who in the group is best suited to decide the common plan in this situation?
group.judge: You are {name} (id {id}). Judge the common plan proposed for the group {group}. Reply only with JSON: {"pass": true if it is fine as it is, "feedback": "what to change, in English"}.
group.crowdHeader: You are jointly guiding these people from the crowd. Decide what each of them will do in the next {horizon} minutes.
group.chainScout: You are {name} (id {id}), the scout for the group {group}. Report in a few sentences what you see and what matters, in English.
group.chainPlanner: You are {name} (id {id}), the planner for the group {group}.
group.chainDoer: You are {name} (id {id}), the doer for the group {group}. Refine the common plan and fix it with the commit_plan tool.
group.previous:
What the person before you said:
{text}
group.commitPlan: Fix the proposed common plan: a list of steps, each with who (id of the member doing it).
